t: You're in St Patrick's Roman Catholic Cemetery in Leytonstone, with mature oak, plane and sycamore trees among the paths. Look out for the modernist Ferrari mausoleum, which dates from 1965. Mary Jane Kelly, widely believed to be the final victim of Jack the Ripper, is buried here. So is the actor Stephen Lewis, known as Blakey in On the Buses, and Patrick Mullane, who won the Victoria Cross. William Hitchcock, father of Alfred Hitchcock, is also buried here.
